title: New York Post Hosts Game 1 Watch Party for NBA Finals
text:
The New York Post threw a Game 1 watch party at Magic Hour as the Empire State Building glowed in Knicks blue and orange in the background. Knick fans packed Madison Square Garden and Central Park's SummerStage to watch Game 1 of the NBA Finals against the San Antonio Spurs.
The New York Post threw a Game 1 watch party at Magic Hour as the Empire State Building glowed in Knicks blue and orange in the background on Wednesday.
Knicks fans watch Game 1 of the NBA Finals against the San Antonio Spurs at Madison Square Garden on June 3, 2026. Knick fans react as they watch Game 1 of the NBA Finals at the New York Post’s watch party on Wednesday. Manhattan buildings lit up in blue and orange were seen during Game 1 of the NBA Finals between the Knicks and Spurs on June 3, 2026.
Knicks fans watch game 1 of the NBA Finals against the San Antonio Spurs at Madison Square Garden in New York City. Knicks fans packed MSG on Wednesday night to watch Game 1 of the NBA Finals against the San Antonio Spurs. Knicks fans erupted at Madison Square Garden on Wednesday night after New York took Game 1 of the NBA Finals over the San Antonio Spurs.
Madison Square Garden exploded in excitement on Wednesday night as the Knicks took Game 1 of the NBA Finals over the San Antonio Spurs. New York Knicks fans gathered at Central Park’s SummerStage on Wednesday for a watch party for Game 1 of the NBA Finals against the San Antonio Spurs.

Mark Rosewater's New Card Game, Mood Swings, is a Game-Changer for Trading Card EnthusiastsMagic: The Gathering head designer Mark Rosewater has been working on his own card game, Mood Swings, for 28 years. This new game is designed for two-to-four players and features a simpler rule set and lower barrier to entry than Magic: The Gathering. The game is based on emotions, with cards named after feelings like Anger and Self-Loathing. Card abilities tie in thematically with the emotions they're named after, making for a unique and engaging gameplay experience. The first edition of Mood Swings is a set of 134 cards, with a special headliner card featuring art from Rosewater himself. Each box of Mood Swings comes with a random assortment of 45 cards from the set, making each game play differently and offering a variety of strategies for players to explore.
